query: A Letter From the Seven Towers Silver wax, seven little towers in it. The Conclave writes that Professor Thorne has mentioned your name, "more than once and without being asked", and offers you an apprenticeship at the Seven Towers after graduation. Your answer is due on the last day. Write back that you're interested You write three drafts and send the shortest. Thorne passes you in the corridor the next day and says "Hm," which from him is a parade. Ask what an apprentice actually does The answer comes by return: long hours, a grey robe, and seven years before anyone lets you near a real ward. It is less glamorous on paper. The offer stands.

results.excerpt:
A Letter of Recommendation
Thorne calls you to his office and slides an envelope across the desk. "The Conclave asked for my recommendations. I wrote one. I don't write many." He pauses. "Don't make me regret it."
Thank him sincerely
"Go away," he says gruffly. "I have marking."
